assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation sprite sheet for a 2.5D top-down pixel-art RPG. Reference image is the exact hero identity and style: white spiky hair, large dark eyes, red scarf trailing behind, navy blue tunic with cream cuffs and hem, brown belt, dark gloves and trousers, brown boots. Keep the same chibi proportions, hair, clothing, palette, outline and detailed restrained pixel shading. No sword: it is drawn separately by game code. Create a genuine transparent-background sheet, exactly 6 columns by 3 rows, 18 full-body frames, canvas 2304x1152 with square equal cells. Each row is one coherent six-frame looping WALK animation. Row 1 facing down toward camera, row 2 facing away/up, row 3 facing screen right in profile. Left direction will be mirrored in code. In each row: left-foot contact, left-leg passing, neutral step, right-foot contact, right-leg passing, neutral step. Real leg and arm movement, small alternating boot advance; no jumps, no running, no rigid copies. Keep head and torso dimensions consistent, smooth cyclic cadence with the sixth frame returning to the first. Every frame centered inside its own cell; boots near common bottom baseline, generous transparent margins, no cropped hair or scarf, identical camera and lighting in all frames. Crisp pixel-art edges. No labels, captions, grid lines, ground, shadows outside the character, glow or background. Only the exact same hero repeated in animation poses.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production DODGE ROLL animation sprite sheet for a 2.5D top-down pixel-art RPG. Reference image locks the hero identity: white spiky hair, red scarf, navy tunic with cream cuffs and hem, brown belt, dark gloves/trousers and brown boots, the same chibi body proportions, bold clean pixel edges and detailed pixel shading. No sword. Genuine transparent background. Exactly 6 columns by 3 rows, 18 frames, canvas 2304x1152 in equal square cells. Each row depicts a readable forward somersault sequence, NOT a rigid rotation of an upright person. Row 1 rolls toward camera/down, row 2 rolls away from camera/up, row 3 rolls toward screen right in profile. Left will be mirrored by game code. For EACH row left to right: 1 knees bend and torso leans into the roll; 2 compact crouch with chin tucked and hands close; 3 shoulders contact ground and knees folded tightly over chest; 4 compact inverted somersault, boots overhead and back curled; 5 boots return to ground in a low crouch; 6 rises toward normal upright stance. Anatomy remains recognizably the same hero, scarf follows the motion and never becomes long trails. Each roll stays in its cell with generous transparent margins. Keep the exact same head size, body mass and pixel density across the whole sheet; a curled pose naturally occupies less height. Full unfolded standing height would be 300 pixels in a 384 pixel cell; crouch and tumble must be smaller, never enlarged to fill a cell. Same camera, lighting and texture all frames. No speed lines, magic, dust, text, numbers, grid, background, floor, detached limbs, duplicate extra bodies or watermark.

normalization: The user has authorized sprite-sheet resizing and frame packing. Originals remain in sources; no hand-painted replacement artwork.
